sentences.japanese: 僕が最後に自分の考えを伝えた人は、僕を気違いだと思ったようだ。
sentences.english: The last person I told my idea to thought I was nuts.

sentences.japanese: 最悪の場合を考えておこう。
sentences.english: Let's consider the worst that could happen.

sentences.japanese: 行き過ぎたものであっても、僕は自分の考えをなくしたくない。
sentences.english: I don't want to lose my ideas, even though some of them are a bit extreme.

sentences.japanese: 彼らのコミュニケーションは我々が考えてきたものよりはるかに複雑かもしれません。
sentences.english: Their communication may be much more complex than we thought.

sentences.japanese: いままで試してきた他の政治形態を除いて考えると、民主主義とは最低の政治形態だ。
sentences.english: Democracy is the worst form of government, except all the others that have been tried.
